claim: The identity of tail index T6 and T2.
locus_A: SI p.4 names eight epoxide tails -- (R)- and (S)- glycidyl octanoate, decanoate, dodecanoate and tetradecanoate -- and never maps any of them to a T index
locus_B: Figure S2 title/caption pairs "R-configured (H9T2)" with "S-configured (H9T6)" as a stereo pair; the index gap is 4, the number of chain lengths
what_we_emitted: T6 = (S)-glycidyl decanoate, emitted. H9T2 is NOT emitted.
why: T6 = C10 is established INDEPENDENTLY of the index arithmetic, three ways: the LC-MS ladder assigns all three published m/z at C10 and none at C8/C12/C14 (worst 0.14 Da vs 78 Da); the 1H NMR bulk-CH2 integral of 72H requires 6 CH2 per tail beyond Halpha/Hbeta/CH3, which is decanoyl exactly; and the R/S pairing is consistent with it. For H9T2 only the third of those is available, so its chain length rests on index arithmetic alone and it is not emitted.
